title: AutoformBench: A Lean Formalization Benchmark for Advanced Mathematics
abstract: arXiv:2611.33165v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI systems are increasingly capable of producing machine-checked Lean proofs of advanced mathematical results. Real mathematical formalization, however, is not isolated theorem proving: it requires building the definitions and intermediate lemmas that connect a result to a formal library. Existing evaluations often provide isolated theorem statements in settings where much of this supporting theory is already available in Mathlib. We introduce AutoformBench, a benchmark of 341 Lean 4 formalization tasks drawn from 24 advanced mathematical sources. Lean-experienced mathematicians formalized and audited each target statement, leaving the corresponding Lean proof to the evaluated agent. Each problem is embedded in a broader mathematical development: agents receive the informal proof but must translate it into Lean while constructing the missing definitions, intermediate lemmas, and supporting infrastructure. translated_title: AutoformBench：面向高等数学的 Lean 形式化基准
translated_abstract: 人工智能系统在为高等数学结果生成经机器验证的 Lean 证明方面能力日益增强。然而，真正的数学形式化并非孤立的定理证明：它需要构建将结果与形式化库相连接的定义和中间引理。现有评估往往在 Mathlib 中大部分支撑理论已经可用的环境下提供孤立的定理陈述。我们提出 AutoformBench，这是一个包含 341 个 Lean 4 形式化任务的基准，任务取自 24 个高等数学来源。具有 Lean 经验的数学家对每个目标陈述进行了形式化并加以审核，而将相应的 Lean 证明留给被评估的智能体完成。每个问题都嵌入在更广泛的数学发展体系中：智能体会获得非形式化的证明，但必须将其翻译为 Lean，同时构建缺失的定义、中间引理和支撑基础设施。我们比较了……的性能（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: AutoformBench 提出了一个包含 341 个 Lean 4 形式化任务的基准，要求 AI 智能体在构建缺失定义、中间引理和支撑基础设施的前提下，将来自 24 个高等数学来源的非形式化证明翻译为完整可验证的 Lean 代码，从而更真实地评估数学形式化能力
en_tdlr: AutoformBench introduces a benchmark of 341 Lean 4 formalization tasks from 24 advanced mathematical sources, requiring AI agents to translate informal proofs into Lean while constructing missing definitions, intermediate lemmas, and supporting infrastructure, enabling a more realistic evaluation of mathematical formalization ability
